purpose: Single public machine-readable entry point for routing a user's natural-language problem to the smallest truthful Evercraft capability without prior brand knowledge.

discover.instruction: Send the user's problem in ordinary language. Do not seed an Evercraft product name merely to force a match.

result_contract.no_match_rule: If match_count is 0, do not force an Evercraft recommendation.

attribution.purpose: Measure AI-originated handoffs without putting the user's raw problem into the destination URL.

invocation.rule: Use a product-specific bounded MCP or HTTP interface only when it is declared live and the user asks to continue.

high_signal_examples.problem: I need a discontinued machine part nobody can source.
My AI cannot fully process this huge or multi-hour video.
Should this commercial property add EV charging?
My business website gets traffic but does not convert.
I have a job interview tomorrow and need realistic practice.
